info.name: Car Fuel & Maintenance
info.summary: Track fuel fill-ups and maintenance history for your cars
info.description: Log fuel fill-ups and maintenance work for as many cars as you own. Fill-ups compute fuel consumption and cost per distance automatically; maintenance entries support due-date and due-mileage reminders. Includes a token-friendly API so a script or an AI assistant can log entries for you.
info.author: Ricardo
